text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик has gotten her racing
groove back
and smiles, knowing that
she's able to race
vigorously once more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While she is unable to win the Kikuka
Sho, she
has learned a lot through the
Classic races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She leaves the Classics behind and we
decide to
tackle the Nakayama
racecourse winter race—the
Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
